evidence.ev_charging: Only source is a resident review (ApartmentRatings 2021-01) mentioning free EV charging; may be outdated

evidence.concierge: Residents (ApartmentRatings, mostly 2021 or earlier) praise 24-hour concierge; not on current official list
evidence.bike_storage: Residents (2020-12) mention an indoor locked bike room
evidence.roof_deck: Official: '15,000 SF Garden Terrace' (unclear whether it is on the roof)
